commission_instruction: Bind the exact F8 boundary: service-source applicability may make a source ELIGIBLE. It does NOT thereby authorize conditioning, possibility-geometry transformation, probability/distribution transformation, respondent pooling or individual inference.
headline: APPLICABILITY CONFERS ELIGIBILITY ONLY. EVERYTHING ELSE IS REFUSED.

the_five_refusals.what_would_be_needed_to_authorise_it: A positive exact conditioning authority binding this source at this retained-conditioner grain.
the_five_refusals.why: Applicability answers 'may this source be used for this service request'. Conditioning answers 'may this source condition this geometry at this retained-conditioner grain'. These are different questions at different grains. Admitting a source says nothing about what it may condition.
the_five_refusals.may_not_be_inferred_because: The F8 conditioning grain is retained_conditioner_ids, an independent axis. A source can be APPLICABLE and still supply no admissible conditioner.

the_five_refusals.what_would_be_needed_to_authorise_it: A positive exact GEOMETRY_TRANSFORMER authority, which does not exist at F8 for any world input family.
the_five_refusals.h_d_finding_relied_upon: H-D @ 2bdd78582a93d334cbdab918c79f4e82c3cf679c, accepted by HQ204: F8_DOES_NOT_TRANSFORM_POSSIBILITY_GEOMETRY. F8 is exact conditional lookup over PRE-MATERIALIZED evidence geometry; geometry arrives on PossibilitySliceEvidence.geometry and is only SELECTED by exact (source_universe, release, target, retained_conditioner_ids) match, or by a governed strictly-decreasing specificity walkback within the same source/release.
the_five_refusals.h_d_verbatim_relied_upon: GEOMETRY_TRANSFORMER and DISTRIBUTION_TRANSFORMER are NOT_AVAILABLE_AT_F8 for any world input family.
the_five_refusals.the_only_way_applicability_can_change_wh: By narrowing which exact source_universe and release are eligible, so a different ALREADY-MATERIALIZED slice is the one selected. It CANNOT create, reshape, recompute, reweight, smooth or extend geometry. A new geometry requires a new upstream materialized slice at a new retained_conditioner grain, produced under its own producer authority.
the_five_refusals.the_trap_this_binding_closes: Because F8 selects by exact (source_universe, release, target, retained_conditioner_ids), narrowing eligibility can change F8's OUTPUT. An implementer could mistake that for a transformation power. It is not: the geometry was already materialized and is unchanged. Output selection is not output transformation.

the_five_refusals.what_would_be_needed_to_authorise_it: A positive exact DISTRIBUTION_TRANSFORMER authority, which does not exist at F8 for any world input family.
the_five_refusals.explicitly_forbidden_by_this_form: No renormalisation, no reweighting, no rescaling, no shifting, no tilting, no mixing, no shrinkage, no calibration and no transport of any distribution, and in particular no operation whose effect would be to 'repair' a thin admitted set by redistributing mass.

the_five_refusals.what_would_be_needed_to_authorise_it: A positively bound SOURCE_COMPOSITION_POOLING authority plus the AUTHORIZED_COMPOSITE operation-scoped bundle plus the exact relation receipts.
the_five_refusals.why: D15 verbatim: 'may not imply respondent linkage or pooling.' Binding default: source_pooling_default false. Admitting five sources is not authorising a five-source sample.

the_five_refusals.what_would_be_needed_to_authorise_it: The full comparator + actor-firewall chain; and even then only a possibility field, never actor state.
the_five_refusals.why: D15 binding non-collapse: POSITIONED_SUBJECT_EMPIRICAL_POSSIBILITY_FIELD != V3_DEVELOPED_OR_REALIZED_DISPOSITION != ACTOR_BELIEF_OR_RESPONSE; and EMPIRICAL_RESPONDENT_COORDINATE != GENERATED_ACTOR_DEMOGRAPHIC_OR_BIOGRAPHICAL_FACT != GENERATED_NINE_STRATUM_STRUCTURAL_POSITION.
the_five_refusals.additionally: This form is decided at SOURCE-UNIVERSE grain and never at person grain. It has no person-level field and must never acquire one.

what_admission_does_authorise_exactly: The source may be PLACED IN AN ADMISSIBLE SET for this exact service request.
It may serve to narrow the source-universe scope of a DOWNSTREAM EmpiricalQuerySpec that the caller independently supplies and that independently carries its own query authority.
It may be reported as eligible, with its admission provenance, in a receipt.
Nothing else. Eligibility is a permission to be CONSIDERED, not a permission to be USED for any particular transformation, and not a permission to be pooled.

ordering_of_the_chain.statement: Applicability is strictly UPSTREAM of query, of structural admission, of composition and of F8.
ordering_of_the_chain.evidence: D15's own POSITIONED_SUBJECT_FIELD_PRODUCTION_AUTHORITY lists 'source applicability' among its upstream_inputs, and STRUCTURAL_EMPIRICAL_ADMISSION_AUTHORITY consumes an already-admitted fact.
ordering_of_the_chain.implication: An applicability decision may be consulted BEFORE a source set is assembled; it may never be consulted to justify an operation already performed.

no_architecture_reopen.statement: This binding requires no F8 architecture change. It forbids operations that current F8 already does not perform.
no_architecture_reopen.basis: Every one of the five refusals above is either already forbidden by current law or already structurally unavailable. The binding adds no new refusal; it forbids an INFERENCE that a newly added authority might otherwise invite.
no_architecture_reopen.h_d_position_preserved: H-D remains PARTIAL per HQ204, but nothing in this derivation alters H-D's base-model finding or its C1 conditionality.
